name: RC-B10-0284/2025/REV1 – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the case of Dr Ahmadreza Djalali in Iran
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is making a public appeal to Iran to free Dr Ahmadreza Djalali, a Swedish-Iranian doctor held since 2016 and sentenced to death after what the Parliament calls an unfair trial. The Parliament also asks Iran to stop executions, let him see doctors and lawyers, and calls on the European Union to put more pressure on Iran, including sanctions and diplomatic efforts.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet; this is a request, not a law.
- **Who it affects:** Dr Djalali, other prisoners in Iran, and European Union nationals held there.
- **What happens next:** The Parliament's President sends the text to Iran, European Union officials and the United Nations.
